views.name: customer_txn_normalized
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date,
  txn_amount,
  txn_type,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN abs(txn_amount)
    ELSE -abs(txn_amount)
  END AS signed_amount,
  -- attempt ISO yyyy-mm-dd from txn_date formats like 2020-01-21 or 01-21-2020 or 2020/01/21; keep original if unknown
  CASE
    WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
    WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
    WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
    ELSE txn_date
  END AS txn_date_iso,
  -- extract year/month/day using sqlite substr on ISO-like txn_date_iso when possible
  CASE
    WHEN length(CASE
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
      ELSE txn_date
    END) >= 10 THEN CAST(substr(
      CASE
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
        ELSE txn_date
      END,1,4) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS txn_year,
  CASE
    WHEN length(CASE
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
      ELSE txn_date
    END) >= 10 THEN CAST(substr(
      CASE
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
        ELSE txn_date
      END,6,2) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS txn_month,
  CASE
    WHEN length(CASE
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
      WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
      ELSE txn_date
    END) >= 10 THEN CAST(substr(
      CASE
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN txn_date
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '/') = 5 AND substr(txn_date,1,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN replace(txn_date,'/','-')
        WHEN instr(txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(txn_date,7,4) GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN substr(txn_date,7,4) || '-' || substr(txn_date,1,2) || '-' || substr(txn_date,4,2)
        ELSE txn_date
      END,9,2) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS txn_day
FROM customer_transactions
views.description: Normalized/cleaned transaction rows for each customer with standardized date and signed amount (deposits positive, other types negative). Keeps one row per original transaction.

views.name: customer_month_calendar_span
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', month_dt) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', month_dt) AS INTEGER) AS month,
  date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', month_dt)) AS month_start_date,
  date(date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', month_dt), '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS month_end_date
FROM (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', MIN(txn_date_iso))) AS first_month_start,
    date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', MAX(txn_date_iso))) AS last_month_start
  FROM customer_txn_normalized
  GROUP BY customer_id
) c,
-- generate months by adding N months to first_month_start where N ranges from 0 to the span in months
(
  SELECT
    date(c.first_month_start, '+' || n || ' months') AS month_dt,
    c.customer_id
  FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17
    UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
    UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29
    UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35
    UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41
    UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47
    UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49 UNION ALL SELECT 50 UNION ALL SELECT 51 UNION ALL SELECT 52 UNION ALL SELECT 53
    UNION ALL SELECT 54 UNION ALL SELECT 55 UNION ALL SELECT 56 UNION ALL SELECT 57 UNION ALL SELECT 58 UNION ALL SELECT 59
    UNION ALL SELECT 60
  ) nums
  JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, first_month_start, last_month_start FROM (
      SELECT
        customer_id,
        date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', MIN(txn_date_iso))) AS first_month_start,
        date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', MAX(txn_date_iso))) AS last_month_start
      FROM customer_txn_normalized
      GROUP BY customer_id
    )
  ) c ON 1=1
  WHERE date(c.first_month_start, '+' || nums.n || ' months') <= c.last_month_start
) months
WHERE months.customer_id = c.customer_id
views.description: All calendar months between each customer's first and last transaction (inclusive). One row per customer per year-month. Useful to ensure months with no transactions are present for that customer.

views.name: customer_monthly_transaction_totals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ctn.customer_id AS customer_id,
  ctn.txn_year AS year,
  ctn.txn_month AS month,
  cmcs.month_start_date AS month_start_date,
  cmcs.month_end_date AS month_end_date,
  SUM(ctn.signed_amount) AS monthly_net_amount,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_txns
FROM customer_txn_normalized ctn
JOIN customer_month_calendar_span cmcs
  ON ctn.customer_id = cmcs.customer_id
  AND ctn.txn_year = cmcs.year
  AND ctn.txn_month = cmcs.month
GROUP BY
  ctn.customer_id,
  ctn.txn_year,
  ctn.txn_month,
  cmcs.month_start_date,
  cmcs.month_end_date
views.description: Monthly aggregated transaction amounts per customer (sum of signed amounts) and monthly transaction existence flag. One row per customer per year-month where transactions occurred (aggregated to month).

views.name: customer_monthly_transactions_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date,
  txn_type,
  txn_amount,
  txn_month
FROM customer_txn_normalized
views.description: Raw transaction rows for customers restricted to a canonical 1-row-per-transaction format. Keeps txn_date, customer_id, txn_type and txn_amount and also a parsed calendar month (YYYY-MM) for each transaction. Useful as base cohort for month-level customer balances and counts.

views.name: customer_monthly_balances
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ctn.customer_id AS customer_id,
  ctn.txn_month AS txn_month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ctn.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ctn.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_sum_deposits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ctn.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN ctn.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_sum_withdrawals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ctn.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ctn.txn_amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN ctn.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN ctn.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_txns
FROM customer_txn_normalized AS ctn
WHERE ctn.txn_type IS NOT "None"
GROUP BY ctn.customer_id, ctn.txn_month
views.description: Aggregated month-level balances per customer: for each customer_id and calendar month (YYYY-MM) compute month_sum_deposits, month_sum_withdrawals, and month_end_balance = deposits - withdrawals. Also expose number_of_txns that month per customer for potential filtering.

views.name: monthly_positive_customer_counts_and_avg_balance
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cmb.txn_month AS txn_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cmb.customer_id) AS distinct_customer_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cmb.month_end_balance > 0 THEN cmb.customer_id END) AS distinct_customers_with_positive_balance,
  AVG(CAST(cmb.month_end_balance AS REAL)) AS avg_month_end_balance_across_customers
FROM
  customer_monthly_balances cmb
GROUP BY
  cmb.txn_month
views.description: Per calendar month (YYYY-MM) metrics: distinct_customer_count (customers with at least one txn that month), distinct_customers_with_positive_balance (count of customers whose month_end_balance > 0), and avg_month_end_balance_across_customers (average of month_end_balance over customers who had any transaction that month). Built from customer_monthly_balances.

views.name: customer_transactions_clean
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date AS txn_date,
  -- month_start_date as first day of month in YYYY-MM-DD; handle various txn_date formats conservatively
  substr(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS month_start_date,
  -- year_month as YYYY-MM (use first 7 chars if ISO-like yyyy-mm-dd, otherwise attempt fallback same)
  substr(txn_date, 1, 7) AS year_month,
  txn_type,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
    ELSE -txn_amount
  END AS signed_amount
FROM customer_transactions
views.description: Normalized/cleaned transaction rows: canonical date, year-month key (first day of month), signed amount (deposits positive, others negative). One row per original transaction.

views.name: customer_monthly_net
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  month_start_date,
  year_month,
  SUM(signed_amount) AS monthly_net
FROM customer_transactions_clean
GROUP BY customer_id, month_start_date, year_month
views.description: Monthly net transaction amount per customer per calendar month (month key is first day of month). Aggregates signed amounts from cleaned transactions.

views.name: customer_monthly_closing_balance
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  n.customer_id,
  n.month_start_date,
  n.year_month,
  n.monthly_net AS monthly_net,
  -- compute running cumulative closing balance per customer ordered by month_start_date
  (SELECT SUM(n2.monthly_net)
   FROM customer_monthly_net n2
   WHERE n2.customer_id = n.customer_id
     AND n2.month_start_date <= n.month_start_date
  ) AS closing_balance
FROM customer_monthly_net n
views.description: Running (cumulative) closing balance per customer at each month-end (ordered by month_start_date ascending). Uses monthly net amounts and computes cumulative sum per customer.

views.name: customer_daily_balance_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date,
  txn_type,
  txn_amount
FROM customer_transactions
views.description: Base transactions/events per customer with date and amount, suitable as the row-level ledger to compute balances by date. Keeps each transaction as one row.

views.name: monthly_first_day_balances_per_customer
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ctn.customer_id AS customer_id,
  cmcs.month_start_date AS month_start_date,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(signed_amount)
    FROM customer_txn_normalized n
    WHERE n.customer_id = ctn.customer_id
      AND DATE(n.txn_date_iso) < DATE(cmcs.month_start_date)
  ), 0) AS balance_as_of_prev_month_start
FROM
  customer_txn_normalized ctn
JOIN
  customer_month_calendar_span cmcs
  ON ctn.customer_id = cmcs.customer_id
GROUP BY
  ctn.customer_id,
  cmcs.month_start_date
views.description: Per customer, for each month (represented by the first day of that month), compute the customer's cumulative balance up to and including the day before that first day. This produces one row per customer per month_key and is intended for computing previous-month totals.

views.name: monthly_customer_balance_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date,
  CAST(txn_amount AS NUMERIC) AS txn_amount,
  -- normalize month start: first day of month in YYYY-MM-01 format
  substr(txn_date,1,7) || '-01' AS month_start_date
FROM customer_txn_normalized
views.description: Normalizes transaction dates into a canonical month_start_date (first day of month) and ensures txn_amount is numeric; exposes columns useful for month-based balance windows.

views.name: customer_daily_signed_balance
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  date(txn_date) AS txn_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS daily_balance
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id, date(txn_date)
views.description: One row per customer per calendar date with the customer's signed daily balance. Deposits are positive, all other txn_type values are negative. Dates cast to canonical YYYY-MM-DD.

views.name: customer_30day_rolling_avg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.customer_id,
  d.txn_date,
  AVG(b.daily_balance) AS rolling_avg_30d
FROM customer_daily_signed_balance b
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, txn_date FROM customer_daily_signed_balance
) d ON d.customer_id = b.customer_id
WHERE b.txn_date <= d.txn_date
  AND date(b.txn_date) >= date(d.txn_date, '-29 days')
GROUP BY d.customer_id, d.txn_date
HAVING COUNT(*) = 30
views.description: For each customer and day where at least 30 calendar days of transaction-history exist up to and including that day, compute the 30-day rolling average of the customer's daily_balance (average over the 30 consecutive calendar days ending on that day). Rows for days with fewer than 30 days of data for that customer are omitted. Rolling averages are raw (can be negative); clipping to zero is a question-op.

views.name: customer_first_transaction_month
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  substr(min(txn_date), 1, 7) AS first_txn_month
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id
views.description: One row per customer giving the calendar month (YYYY-MM) of the first transaction observed for that customer. Used to exclude each customer's baseline month.

views.name: customer_daily_txn_sums
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date,
  SUM(txn_amount) AS daily_net_txn_amount
FROM
  customer_transactions
GROUP BY
  customer_id,
  txn_date
views.description: For each customer and transaction date, compute the net transaction amount (sum of txn_amount) on that date. One row per customer per date that appears in customer_transactions.

views.name: customer_txn_date_range
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  MIN(txn_date) AS min_txn_date,
  MAX(txn_date) AS max_txn_date
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY customer_id
views.description: Per customer, compute the earliest and latest transaction dates (MIN and MAX txn_date) from customer_transactions. Useful to generate per-customer daily series between these bounds.

views.name: customer_daily_balance_template
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_date_iso AS txn_date,
  txn_amount
FROM customer_txn_normalized
views.description: Normalized canonical projection of customer_transactions with txn_date cast/normalized as ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) and txn_amount. Exposes raw transactional rows per customer and date for use in windowing and balance calculations.

views.name: shopping_cart_event_with_page_product_and_event_name
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.visit_id,
  e.cookie_id,
  e.page_id,
  ph.product_id,
  ph.page_name,
  ph.product_category,
  e.event_type,
  ei.event_name,
  e.sequence_number,
  e.event_time
FROM shopping_cart_events e
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph
  ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_event_identifier ei
  ON e.event_type = ei.event_type
WHERE e.page_id IS NOT NULL
views.description: Denormalized event-level rows joined to page hierarchy and event identifier to expose product_id, page_name, product_category and canonical event_name for each shopping cart event.

views.name: shopping_cart_event_type_classification
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sci.event_type AS event_type,
  sci.event_name AS event_name,
  -- page view if event_name contains 'Page View' (case-insensitive match using LIKE)
  CASE WHEN LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%page view%' OR sci.event_name = 'Page View' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_page_view,
  -- add to cart if event_name mentions add-to-cart variants
  CASE WHEN LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%add to cart%' OR LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%add-to-cart%' OR LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%add to basket%' OR sci.event_name = 'Add to Cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_add_to_cart,
  -- purchase-like if event_name mentions purchase/order/checkout
  CASE WHEN LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%purchase%' OR LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%order%' OR LOWER(sci.event_name) LIKE '%checkout%' OR sci.event_name = 'Checkout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_purchase_like
FROM shopping_cart_event_identifier AS sci
GROUP BY sci.event_type, sci.event_name
views.description: Mapping of event_type codes to normalized event categories (is_page_view, is_add_to_cart, is_purchase_like) using shopping_cart_event_identifier.event_name heuristics (case-insensitive contains of 'page view', 'add to cart', 'add-to-cart', 'add to basket', 'purchase', 'order', 'checkout'). Does not hardcode numeric codes; exposes boolean flags per event_type.

views.name: product_cookie_cart_activity
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sce.cookie_id AS cookie_id,
  scph.product_id AS product_id,
  MIN(CASE WHEN sctc.is_add_to_cart = 1 THEN sce.event_time END) AS first_add_to_cart_time,
  MAX(CASE WHEN sctc.is_add_to_cart = 1 THEN sce.event_time END) AS last_add_to_cart_time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sctc.is_add_to_cart = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_to_cart_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sctc.is_purchase_like = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_count,
  MIN(CASE WHEN sctc.is_purchase_like = 1 THEN sce.event_time END) AS first_purchase_time,
  MAX(sce.event_time) AS last_event_time
FROM shopping_cart_events sce
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy scph
  ON sce.page_id = scph.page_id
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_event_type_classification sctc
  ON sce.event_type = sctc.event_type
WHERE scph.product_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sce.cookie_id, scph.product_id
views.description: Per cookie_id and product_id sequence of events (ordered by event_time then sequence_number) showing first add-to-cart time, any purchase times, counts of add-to-cart and purchase events and last event time — useful to detect abandoned-in-cart and counts per product/cookie.

views.name: interest_monthly_metrics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  month_year,
  interest_id,
  SUM(composition) AS composition_sum,
  SUM(index_value) AS index_value_sum,
  AVG(composition) AS composition_avg,
  AVG(index_value) AS index_value_avg,
  COUNT(*) AS rows_in_month
FROM interest_metrics
GROUP BY interest_id, month_year
views.description: Monthly aggregated metrics per interest: sums/averages of composition and index_value and count of records for each interest for a specific month-year. Canonicalizes month/year from interest_metrics.month_year.

views.name: interest_monthly_max_index_composition
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  im.month_year AS month_year,
  im.interest_id AS interest_id,
  AVG(im.composition) AS avg_composition,
  AVG(im.index_value) AS avg_index_value,
  CASE WHEN AVG(im.index_value) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(im.composition) / AVG(im.index_value) END AS avg_composition_per_index,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY im.month_year ORDER BY 
      CASE WHEN AVG(im.index_value) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(im.composition) / AVG(im.index_value) END DESC
  ) AS rank_in_month
FROM interest_metrics im
GROUP BY im.month_year, im.interest_id
views.description: For each month_year, ranks interests by their average composition divided by average index_value (avg_composition_per_index) and exposes the top interest per month with its metric. Keeps one row per month-interest before final top-k selection so it can be reused for different k.

views.name: interest_map_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  imap.id AS interest_id,
  imap.interest_name AS interest_name,
  imap.interest_summary AS interest_summary
FROM interest_map imap
JOIN interest_metrics im ON im.interest_id = imap.id
GROUP BY imap.id, imap.interest_name, imap.interest_summary
views.description: Lookup table mapping interest_id (interest_metrics.interest_id) to human-readable interest_name and interest_summary from interest_map. Used to attach names to interest_id in results.

views.name: interest_monthly_metrics_24
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  interest_id,
  CAST(_month AS INTEGER) AS _month,
  CAST(_year AS INTEGER) AS _year,
  month_year,
  composition
FROM interest_metrics
WHERE interest_id IS NOT NULL
  AND composition IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per interest per month from interest_metrics, keeping raw composition and year/month fields and excluding null interest_id or composition. Normalizes month/year to numeric columns and retains month_year string.

views.name: interest_max_composition_per_interest
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  im._month AS max_month,
  im._year AS max_year,
  im.interest_id AS interest_id,
  im.composition AS max_composition
FROM interest_monthly_metrics_24 im
JOIN (
  SELECT
    interest_id,
    MAX(composition) AS max_composition
  FROM interest_monthly_metrics_24
  WHERE composition IS NOT NULL
    AND interest_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY interest_id
) mx
  ON im.interest_id = mx.interest_id
  AND im.composition = mx.max_composition
WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
  AND im.interest_id IS NOT NULL
views.description: For each interest_id, compute the maximum composition value and the candidate months where that max occurred (keeps _year and _month for disambiguation). This view aggregates composition to the per-interest level but preserves all months that equal the max so a later tie-break (most recent month) can be applied.

views.name: interest_map_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS id,
  interest_name AS interest_name
FROM interest_map
WHERE id IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonicalized interest lookup table exposing id and interest_name for mapping interest_ids to human-readable names. Useful for joining metric aggregates to interest metadata.

views.name: bitcoin_buy_transactions_with_parsed_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bt.txn_id AS txn_id,
  bt.member_id AS member_id,
  bm.region AS region,
  bt.ticker AS ticker,
  -- try to normalize common txn_date formats to ISO YYYY-MM-DD when possible
  CASE
    WHEN instr(bt.txn_date, '-') = 3 AND length(bt.txn_date) >= 8 THEN
      -- assume format DD-MM-YYYY or D-M-YYYY
      substr(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(substr(bt.txn_date, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(substr(bt.txn_date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER))
    WHEN instr(bt.txn_date, '-') = 5 AND length(bt.txn_date) >= 10 THEN
      -- assume format YYYY-MM-DD already
      bt.txn_date
    WHEN instr(bt.txn_date, '/') = 3 OR instr(bt.txn_date, '/') = 2 THEN
      -- assume format DD/MM/YY or DD/MM/YYYY -> try to parse as DD/MM/YYYY
      CASE
        WHEN length(bt.txn_date) - length(replace(bt.txn_date, '/', '')) = 2 THEN
          -- split by '/'
          substr(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(substr(bt.txn_date, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)) || '-' || printf('%02d', CAST(substr(bt.txn_date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER))
        ELSE bt.txn_date
      END
    ELSE bt.txn_date
  END AS txn_date,
  -- extract 4-digit year when possible, else NULL
  CASE
    WHEN instr(bt.txn_date, '-') = 3 THEN substr(bt.txn_date, 7, 4)
    WHEN instr(bt.txn_date, '-') = 5 THEN substr(bt.txn_date, 1, 4)
    WHEN instr(bt.txn_date, '/') >= 2 AND length(bt.txn_date) >= 8 THEN substr(bt.txn_date, -4, 4)
    WHEN length(bt.txn_date) = 4 AND bt.txn_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN bt.txn_date
    ELSE NULL
  END AS txn_year,
  bt.quantity AS quantity
FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
LEFT JOIN bitcoin_members bm
  ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
WHERE
  lower(bt.txn_type) = 'buy'
  AND bt.member_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- ensure year parsed not null using same logic as above
    (instr(bt.txn_date, '-') = 3 AND substr(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) IS NOT NULL)
    OR (instr(bt.txn_date, '-') = 5 AND substr(bt.txn_date, 1, 4) IS NOT NULL)
    OR (instr(bt.txn_date, '/') >= 2 AND length(bt.txn_date) >= 8 AND substr(bt.txn_date, -4, 4) IS NOT NULL)
    OR (length(bt.txn_date) = 4 AND bt.txn_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]')
  )
views.description: Normalized/canonicalized rows of BUY bitcoin transactions joined to member region when available, with transaction year parsed and txn_date normalized where possible. Keeps one row per original bitcoin_transactions row (after filtering non-BUY and parsing failures).

views.name: bitcoin_transaction_prices_joined
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  btxn.txn_id,
  btxn.member_id,
  bm.region,
  btxn.ticker,
  btxn.txn_date,
  btxn.txn_year,
  btxn.quantity,
  bp.price,
  (btxn.quantity * bp.price) AS dollars_spent
FROM bitcoin_buy_transactions_with_parsed_year AS btxn
JOIN bitcoin_members AS bm
  ON bm.member_id = btxn.member_id
JOIN bitcoin_prices AS bp
  ON bp.ticker = btxn.ticker
  AND bp.market_date = btxn.txn_date
WHERE
  lower('BUY') = 'buy' -- placeholder to indicate intrinsic filter applied in source view (kept for concept)
  AND bm.member_id IS NOT NULL
  AND bp.price IS NOT NULL
views.description: Denormalized BUY transaction rows (one per txn_id) joined to bitcoin_prices to attach the per-transaction price (price) and to compute dollars_spent = quantity * price. Excludes transactions without an exact date+ticker price match. Keeps the transaction's member region from bitcoin_members.

views.name: region_year_buy_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  btpj.txn_year AS calendar_year,
  btpj.region AS region,
  SUM(btpj.dollars_spent) AS total_dollars_spent,
  SUM(btpj.quantity) AS total_quantity_purchased,
  CASE WHEN SUM(btpj.quantity) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(btpj.dollars_spent) * 1.0 / SUM(btpj.quantity) END AS avg_purchase_price_per_btc
FROM
  bitcoin_transaction_prices_joined btpj
WHERE
  btpj.ticker = 'BTC'
  AND btpj.dollars_spent IS NOT NULL
  AND btpj.quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  btpj.region,
  btpj.txn_year
HAVING
  SUM(btpj.quantity) > 0
views.description: Aggregated measures per region and calendar year for BUY transactions: total dollars spent and total quantity purchased, along with the derived average purchase price per BTC. Built from priced BUY transactions; one row per region + calendar year.
